payload.title: MCP 3cf50d6: long reviews come back through a 60-second link

issues: With wait_seconds 0, an argument mistake caught inside runReview (task too short, duplicate criteria) returns status "running" with a job_id instead of being refused, because the rejection handler runs only after awaitJob has checked the status.

Several validation checks moved into the background runReview, so with wait_seconds 0 an argument error only shows up later through review_result, not in the sealed_review call; requirement 4 is only partly met.
The diff does not show that receipts.save accepts the new "pending" kind or that SAFE_ID accepts "job_…" ids, so the restart lookup in requirement 7 is unverified.
savePending swallows all errors, so the review is still sent even when the pending record could not be written.
A malformed job_id fails the schema pattern with a generic validation error that does not point to saved_receipts.
In the done result, `...job.result` is spread after status "done" and could overwrite status or job_id if the result has fields with those names.
Finished jobs are never removed from the in-memory jobs Map, so it grows for the life of the process.
The diff cannot show whether any network or budget call runs before the beforeSend hook in the hidden part of runReview.
votes.reasoning: The overall design is sound and covers most requirements. It waits a bounded time, keeps a job map, saves a pending record with SHA-256 fingerprints before sending, updates it to done or failed, stops progress once the call returns, and falls back to the saved record after a restart. However, the argument checks were moved into the async runReview. With wait_seconds 0, awaitJob reads the job status before the rejection is processed, so invalid arguments are reported as a running job instead of being refused. Some store-side assumptions (save kinds, the SAFE_ID pattern, the sha256Hex export) cannot be verified from the diff. These problems should be fixed before the change is used.

issues: savePending() suppresses all disk-write errors, so sealed_review can send a billable request even though the required pending record was not saved; it can also return done without persisting the receipt metadata.
votes.reasoning: The change otherwise implements bounded waiting, in-process jobs, result retrieval without resending, and saved-record lookup after restart. However, the requirement that a pending record be saved before anything is sent is not guaranteed: savePending catches write failures and allows execution to continue. The same suppression means completion can be reported even when the updated record was not saved.

The diff completely and correctly implements all requirements. It adds `wait_seconds` to `sealed_review` with proper defaults and ranges, manages background review execution via job tracking, saves and updates pending records with SHA-256 fingerprints before sending, suppresses progress notifications once the initial call returns, and introduces `review_result` with lookup fallback to saved receipts on server restart.

payload.note: A review records what these AI models said about this exact task and output, both chosen by the agent that paid. It is not a guarantee the output is correct. Reviewers saw only the text (no tools, web or code execution), and a review is one sample: running it again can give a different verdict.
